parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The granularity of the performance data. Valid values:

- 5

- 30

- 60

- 600

- 1800

- 3600

- 86400

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description:
The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~141787~~).

> Specify up to five performance metrics.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
